Silicon Valley AI Startup Incentive Program 2024

Tax Incentives:
- Corporate Tax Reduction: 15% tax rate for qualified AI companies
- R&D Tax Credit: 50% credit for qualified research expenses
- Investment Tax Credit: 20% credit for qualifying capital investments

Grants and Funding:
- Startup Grant: Up to $1M for innovative AI projects
- Series A Matching: 1:1 match for first $500K in VC funding
- University Partnerships: $250K for Stanford/Berkeley collaborations

Talent Support:
- Visa Sponsorship: H1B and O1 visa assistance
- Housing Grants: $10,000 relocation assistance
- Education Support: Stanford tuition discount for employees

Infrastructure:
- Office Space: 6 months free in Santa Clara tech park
- Cloud Credits: $100K AWS/Azure credits
- Lab Access: Stanford AI lab partnership

Regulatory Sandbox:
- Expedited permitting: 30-day approval process
- Data Privacy: GDPR-compliant testing environment
- Market Access: Beta testing with major tech companies
